title: 2018 Panini Prizm #139 Emmanuel Sanders Denver Broncos Football Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: For all the NFL fans out there, here is a great opportunity to add to your collection. This 2018 Panini Prizm sports trading card, featuring Emmanuel Sanders from the Denver Broncos, is perfect for any collector. With a Prizm parallel/variety and base set feature, this card is a must-have for any serious collector who is looking to complete their set. The card number is 139 and it's part of the 2018 season. This card is sure to be a great addition to your collection.
